params.caption: 🎮 A Call of Duty chat got a plane evacuated in California A Frontier Airlines flight and the east wing of Terminal 2 at Ontario International Airport were evacuated before departure after another passenger mistook a FaceTime call about Call of Duty multiplayer for a bomb threat, police said. The gamer was detained and released, and the flight later left without further incident. 🕒 Nov 10, 2026 · 03:08 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: IGN #CallOfDuty #GamingNews
